client.stacksPrompt: Build an eight-week Stacks launch story. Teach the value of one cohesive TypeScript toolkit, show Buddy, STX, Craft, the ORM, queues, AI, and cloud deployment in action, and be candid that the project is pre-alpha with alpha and beta ahead. Emphasize useful engineering lessons over hype.
client.fullPrompt: Build a balanced story from early awareness through launch and follow-up.
client.launchPrompt: Focus this sequence around launch week, with anticipation, launch-day clarity, and follow-up.
client.educationPrompt: Lead with useful lessons for our audience and keep direct promotion secondary.
client.proofPrompt: Emphasize demonstrations, credible evidence, and concrete outcomes.
client.fillPrompt: Study the posts already planned and fill missing pillars or quiet dates without repeating ideas.
client.assistantIntroAI: I can use your campaign brief, connected channels, and existing calendar to build a structured plan with Stacks AI.
client.assistantIntroLocal: I can build a reliable local plan now. Configure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama to make the drafts respond more deeply to your direction.

labels.workspaceHelp: Schedules, campaigns and the best-time chart all use this time zone.

labels.shareImages: Share images through a temporary link
labels.publishingHelp: While paused, scheduled posts stay in the queue and nothing goes out on its own. Publishing by hand still works. A post that comes due more than its grace period before you resume is held as missed.
labels.appearanceHelp: Automatic follows the appearance your system is set to.
labels.alertsHelp: Postline records failed or missed posts, expired channel sign-ins, and Listening matches in Activity.

labels.twoFactorHelp: After the password, Postline asks for a code from an authenticator app such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy. Recovery codes stand in for the phone if you lose it; each works once.

labels.signOutHelp: Signing out ends this session on the server and clears it from this browser.
labels.signOutEverywhereHelp: Ends every session and revokes every token, on every browser and device, this one included. Use it if a device is lost or a token may have leaked.
labels.dataKeywords: export import backup move delete everything archive
labels.archiveHelp: One JSON file with your posts and their results, threads, campaigns, blog posts, Listening rules, settings and the images on queued posts. Network sign-ins, app keys and the AI key stay here; connect them again on the other install.
labels.importHelp: Up to 64 MB from another Postline install. Applies the exported workspace settings and adds missing records.
labels.deleteDataHelp: Deletes every post, result, campaign, blog post, Listening rule, inbox copy, connected account, network app and image in this workspace, on this install. Your posts on the networks themselves are not touched. Export first if you may want any of it.
